verdict.rationale: Dropbox Dash offers natural-language interaction with content: AI search across apps with clear answers, AI summarization, document review, and AI-assisted organization. Dropbox's homepage also says AI is coming for smarter search and intelligent organization. This covers natural-language querying of files, but nothing shows natural-language commands operating the product itself (moving, sharing, or managing files). Some of the messaging is also future-tense ('AI is coming'). missing for 10: documented natural-language commands for core file operations (move/share/delete/permissions), detail on Dash's command scope, hands-on or independent corroboration.
